definition: A dataset consisting of pairs (or rankings) of model outputs annotated with human (or AI) judgments about which is preferred, used to train reward models or perform direct preference optimization.
details: Preference datasets are central to modern alignment techniques like RLHF and DPO, capturing nuanced human judgments about response quality that are difficult to specify through simple rule-based criteria alone.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Preference Dataset — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
